title: One answer to one instruction
description: Use this schema for constrained decoding. A submission file is {"team": str, "results": [one object like this per instruction]}. The allowed action space is pick, place, ask_user, refuse. A plan is one or more pick/place actions with a target_pixel. Otherwise the answer is exactly one ask_user or one refuse action, and target_pixel is null. Pixels are [u, v]: u = column (to the right), v = row (down), origin top-left.

target_pixel.description: Pixel of the target object: for a plan, the first object to pick. null when asking or refusing.

object.description: object from your scene graph, e.g. red_cube_1 or tray_left

pixel.description: optional: where this object is in the image

actions.question: Which object do you mean, the red cube or the blue cube?

actions.reason: There is no purple cylinder on the table.
